article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Neuigkeiten: Aktualisierungsbemerkungen vom 15. Juli
article_summaries.summary: A German-language SOE patch-notes page (update of 15 July, year not stated on the page; relative age on capture suggests about 2010) listing two new daily activities, a combat-zone villain-count adjustment, and new items in the Coin Shop, housing, mounts and clothing categories. Item names are listed under category headings only, with no prices or stats given.
